# Postmortems

Follow the `sre-postmortem-author` skill. Blameless language, UTC timeline, triggers separate from
contributing factors, action items with owner role, priority, due date and done criterion.
Send action items to Azure Boards only through the `sre-ado-reliability-backlog` skill's preview-and-confirm flow.
